sectionPath: GENERAL PROVISIONS FOR AIR TRAFFIC SERVICES
primaryBlock.normalizedText:
Transfer of communications to the aerodrome controller should be effected at such a point, level or time
that clearance to land or alternative instructions, as well as information on essential local traffic, can be issued in a timely
manner.

sectionPath: GENERAL PROVISIONS FOR AIR TRAFFIC SERVICES
memberUnits.normalizedText:
Even though there is an approach control unit, control of certain flights may be transferred directly from an
ACC to an aerodrome control tower and vice versa, by prior arrangement between the units concerned for the relevant
part of approach control service to be provided by the ACC or the aerodrome control tower, as applicable.
